'''Lian''' was a legendary [[Hunter of the Horn]] and [[Horn of Valere|Hero of the Horn]].

== History ==
One of the great stories in "[[The Great Hunt of the Horn]]" is "Lian's Stand." [[Thom Merrilin]] tells the story of Lian's Stand at [[The Stag and Lion]] in [[Baerlon]].{{ref/book|1|17}}

According to [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], like [[Rogosh Eagle-Eye]] and [[Gaidal Cain]], Lian became a Hero of the Horn.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lian}}
